content.title: 3 restaurant stock picks as consumers cut back on eating out
content.description:
Restaurant stocks are in focus after names like McDonald's (MCD) and Cava (CAVA) released earnings and highlighted a pullback in consumers eating out.

content.title: 3 Reasons DRI is Risky and 1 Stock to Buy Instead
content.summary: Over the past six months, Darden’s stock price fell to $180.10. Shareholders have lost 9.3% of their capital, which is disappointing considering the S&P 500 has climbed by 21.3%. This was partly driven by its softer quarterly results and may have investors wondering how to approach the situation.
